Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.230 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Fakharpur, District Bahraich.

3.  The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 17.02.2024 and sufficient dowry was also given, however, the entire matrimonial family used to harass her.
Subsequently, on 09.06.2024, she was killed by her matrimonial family.
The postmortem report indicates the cause of death due to ante mortem Badalu Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the postmortem report indicating no injury except for ligature mark and there being nothing against the applicant to suggest that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to any demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 12.06.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantBadalu Yadav be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
